title: Anthropic client defaults to the hosted API
explanation: The anthropic package is installed and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL isn't set, so clients created without base_url call api.anthropic.com. Code may still pass base_url explicitly, which this rule can't see.

evidence.detail: anthropic 0.40.0 installed; not disabled in the image (none of ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=*)

fix: Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to an in-enclave gateway, or remove the hosted dependency.
